faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the questions we hear most often.

sections.heading: How long does shipping take?
sections.body: Orders placed before 2 PM ship the same day. Delivery takes 2–5 business days depending on your location.

sections.heading: Do you offer custom builds?
sections.body: Yes. Start from the Custom Builds page or contact our support team and we will design a rig around your budget and use case.

sections.heading: What is covered by the warranty?
sections.body: Every pre-built PC and component we sell is covered.
items: Defective parts replaced within 2 years
Free labor and diagnostics on pre-built PCs
Lifetime technical support on our builds

sections.heading: Can I return an opened product?
sections.body: Yes, most items can be returned within 30 days as long as they are in original condition and packaging.

shipping-and-returns.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping-and-returns.intro: Everything you need to know about getting your gear and sending it back.

sections.heading: Processing
sections.body: In-stock items are packed and dispatched within 1 business day. Pre-built PCs are assembled, tested, and quality-checked before leaving our workshop.

sections.heading: Delivery times
sections.body: Standard shipping takes 2–5 business days depending on your region.
items: Free 2-day shipping on orders over $100
Express next-day shipping available at checkout
Live tracking provided via email and SMS

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: You have 30 days from delivery to request a return.
items: Items must be in original condition with all accessories
Return shipping is free for defective or damaged products
Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 7 days

sections.heading: Damaged or defective items
sections.body: If your order arrives damaged or stops working, contact support within 30 days and we will arrange a replacement or refund right away.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.intro: We stand behind every build and every part we sell.

sections.heading: Pre-Built PCs
sections.body: All pre-built systems include a 2-year warranty covering parts and labor. We repair or replace any faulty component at no cost.

sections.heading: Components
sections.body: Individual components carry a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of purchase.

sections.heading: What is not covered
items: Physical damage caused by misuse or accidents
Liquid damage or electrical surges
Modifications outside of manufacturer specifications
Cosmetic wear and tear

sections.heading: How to claim
sections.body: Contact our support team with your order number and a description of the issue. We will send you a prepaid shipping label and process the claim.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, shipping address, and payment details, as well as technical data like device and usage information.

sections.heading: How we use your information
items: Process and deliver your orders
Provide customer support
Send order updates and promotions you opt in to
Improve and secure our website

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to remember your preferences, keep your cart, and understand how visitors use the site. See our Cookies page for details.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us. We never sell your data to third parties.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.intro: The rules and guidelines for using PcHub.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing or purchasing from PcHub you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: Orders and pricing
sections.body: Prices are shown in USD and may change without notice. We reserve the right to cancel any order affected by pricing errors or stock issues.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on this site, including text, graphics, logos, and product imagery, is the property of PcHub and may not be reused without permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: PcHub is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of our products or services, to the maximum extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

blog.title: Blog
blog.intro: Build guides, hardware reviews, and news from the PcHub team.

sections.heading: Building guides
sections.body: Step-by-step tutorials for every skill level, from your first budget build to a fully custom water-cooled rig.

sections.heading: Hardware reviews
sections.body: Hands-on testing of the latest GPUs, CPUs, memory, and storage so you can buy with confidence.

sections.heading: Industry news
sections.body: Stay up to date with new releases, price drops, and upcoming hardware launches. New articles drop every week.

careers.title: Careers
careers.intro: Join the team that builds the gaming PCs everyone wants.

sections.heading: Join the team
sections.body: We are always looking for passionate builders, engineers, and customer heroes to grow with us.

sections.heading: Why work with us
items: Work on high-end gaming and workstation hardware
Small team, real impact, no corporate bloat
Flexible hours and remote-friendly roles
Employee discounts on everything we sell

sections.heading: Open positions
sections.body: Send your resume to careers@pc-hub.example with a short note about why you want to build with us. We reply to every applicant.

custom-builds.title: Custom Builds
custom-builds.intro: Tell us your budget and goals and we will build your dream machine.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Reach out with your budget and what you want the PC for. Our team designs a build, shares the full part list and price, and starts building once you approve.

sections.heading: What we offer
items: Gaming, streaming, and workstation configurations
Perfect cable management and tested stability
RGB tuning and quiet fan profiles
2-year parts and labor warranty

sections.heading: Get started
sections.body: Visit the contact page or email builds@pc-hub.example and a builder will get back to you within 24 hours.

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.intro: A team of gamers and builders obsessed with perfect PCs.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: PcHub started as a small workshop building PCs for friends. Today we ship pre-built and custom systems to gamers everywhere, but we still test every machine like it is our own.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: To make high-performance PCs accessible to everyone by combining honest advice, quality parts, and build perfection.

sections.heading: Why gamers choose us
items: Every build hand-assembled and stress-tested
Real builders on support, not scripts
Competitive pricing with a 2-year warranty
A community that helps you upgrade smarter

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: What cookies are and how we use them on PcHub.

sections.heading: What are cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites remember your preferences and work efficiently.

sections.heading: How we use cookies
items: Essential cookies to keep the site and cart working
Preference cookies to remember your choices
Analytics cookies to understand how the site is used

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time. Note that some parts of the site, like the shopping cart, may not work without them.
